set -eu
trap 'rm -f /tmp/infraset-final-public.body /tmp/infraset-final-backend.body' EXIT
printf 'infraset-nodejs_enabled=%s\n' "$(systemctl is-enabled infraset-nodejs.service)"
printf 'infraset-nodejs_active=%s\n' "$(systemctl is-active infraset-nodejs.service)"
printf 'haproxy_enabled=%s\n' "$(systemctl is-enabled haproxy.service)"
printf 'haproxy_active=%s\n' "$(systemctl is-active haproxy.service)"
sudo -n systemd-analyze verify /etc/systemd/system/infraset-nodejs.service
sudo -n /usr/sbin/haproxy -c -f /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg
node_pid=$(systemctl show infraset-nodejs.service -p MainPID | sed 's/^MainPID=//')
test "$node_pid" != 0
ps -p "$node_pid" -o user= -o group= -o pid= -o comm=
sudo -n ss -ltnp | awk '$4 ~ /:80$/ || $4 ~ /:3000$/ {print}'
backend_code=$(curl --noproxy '*' -sS -o /tmp/infraset-final-backend.body -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:3000/)
public_code=$(curl --noproxy '*' -sS -o /tmp/infraset-final-public.body -w '%{http_code}' "http://$NODE_IP/")
printf 'backend_http_code=%s backend_body=%s backend_bytes=%s\n' "$backend_code" "$(cat /tmp/infraset-final-backend.body)" "$(wc -c < /tmp/infraset-final-backend.body | tr -d ' ')"
printf 'public_http_code=%s public_body=%s public_bytes=%s\n' "$public_code" "$(cat /tmp/infraset-final-public.body)" "$(wc -c < /tmp/infraset-final-public.body | tr -d ' ')"
test "$backend_code" = 200
test "$(cat /tmp/infraset-final-backend.body)" = infraset-nodejs
test "$(wc -c < /tmp/infraset-final-backend.body | tr -d ' ')" = 15
test "$public_code" = 200
test "$(cat /tmp/infraset-final-public.body)" = infraset-nodejs
test "$(wc -c < /tmp/infraset-final-public.body | tr -d ' ')" = 15
commands.stdout:
infraset-nodejs_enabled=enabled
infraset-nodejs_active=active
haproxy_enabled=enabled
haproxy_active=active
Configuration file is valid

backend_http_code=200 backend_body=infraset-nodejs backend_bytes=15
public_http_code=200 public_body=infraset-nodejs public_bytes=15
